title: Bundle footprint report (zic-rs-size-report-v1)
description: Read-only footprint of a produced --out tree for container/embedded image builders (T21): tzif_files / symlink_links / other_files counts, total + tzif bytes, largest TZif, version histogram, footer_present, and a deterministic bundle_hash (sorted (relpath, content-hash)). Never compiles/writes/admits. Non-claims: does NOT distinguish a zone from a copy-mode link (needs alias-map.json), makes no runtime/reader approval claim, and bundle_hash is a determinism witness, not a signed attestation. Published contract scope: this pins the schema identity (the `schema` const) and the top-level object shape; field-level tightening + full instance-validation are a tracked audit-suite item (the core crate carries no validator dependency). See docs/schema-compatibility-policy.md and tests/schemas.rs.

schema.description: the immutable schema identity; bumped only on a meaning change
